nodes.label: Mega Filter (excluded by default, includeMega=true)
nodes.rationale: Mega links include an encryption key in the URL hash (#) which browsers may strip during copy/paste or redirects, causing a manual key prompt popup. Excluded by default to avoid user confusion.

nodes.label: Module Depth (leverage at interface)
nodes.rationale: Depth is measured as leverage at the interface: a deep module has a large amount of behaviour behind a small interface. A shallow module has an interface nearly as complex as its implementation. Based on Ousterhout's philosophy but uses depth-as-leverage rather than implementation-lines-to-interface-lines ratio.

nodes.label: Seam Discipline (one adapter = hypothetical, two = real)
nodes.rationale: One adapter at a seam means it's hypothetical (just indirection). Two adapters (typically production + test) means the seam is real. Don't introduce a port unless at least two adapters are justified.
nodes.norm_label: seam discipline (one adapter = hypothetical, two = real)

nodes.label: Deletion Test
nodes.rationale: Imagine deleting a module. If complexity vanishes, the module was a pass-through. If complexity reappears across N callers, the module was earning its keep.

nodes.label: Design It Twice (parallel sub-agent interface exploration)
nodes.rationale: Based on Ousterhout's 'Design It Twice' principle: your first idea is unlikely to be the best. Spawn 3+ sub-agents in parallel, each with a radically different design constraint (minimize interface, maximize flexibility, optimize for common caller), then compare by depth, locality, and seam placement.
nodes.norm_label: design it twice (parallel sub-agent interface exploration)

nodes.label: Anti-Fake Video Filter (isLikelyVideoUrl)
nodes.rationale: Video servers like StreamWish, VOE, and VidHide serve fake placeholder videos (Big Buck Bunny, test-videos) when detecting automated access. The isLikelyVideoUrl filter rejects these URLs to prevent returning garbage to users.
